scope: Proposition 6.1 (Entropy from ordinary balls) of the manuscript “Equidistribution of Prime-Degree Torus Packets with Arbitrary Local Type” (preprints/Equidistribution-of-Prime-Degree-Torus-Packets-with-Arbitrary-Local-Type-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 015 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7e6a0188abd45ae4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n ≥ 3 and let µ be an An-invariant probability on Xn. Suppose that for every compact Ω ⊂ Xn there are CΩ, rΩ > 0 such that µ(xB(r)) ≤ CΩrn (x ∈ Ω, 0 < r < rΩ). Then every An-invariant probability ξ satisfying ξ ≤ cµ for some finite c has hξ(a(1)) ≥ λ/3.
